DECISION FOR MATT, not a bug. Now that /admin/audit-log can actually be read (42P17 fixed 2026-08-09), the trail it shows is nearly empty for a second reason: admin_actions holds ONE row, dated 2026-03-31. logAdminAction() uses a service client so writes were never blocked; it is simply wired into app/actions/{admin-media,admin-listing-detail,admin-roles,banners,site-pages,brokerage,brokers}.ts and nowhere else. NOT logged: CRM sends (SMS/email), blog publish/unpublish, TC envelope actions, approval-queue decisions, bulk operations. ADMIN_UI §6 says dark mode ships from day one and the P6 lock records 'DECIDED (Matt): ship both'. It is NOT reachable: nothing in the codebase sets data-theme (grepped app/, components/, lib/ — the attribute appears only in the two tokens.css files). Measured 2026-08-08 by forcing it pre-hydration: the admin's own tokens flip correctly (--a-text #1c2024 -> #edeef0, panes/charts/map all follow), but document.body stays lab(100 0 0) = WHITE, so every dark token would render light-on-white and the surface would be unusable. Two things to decide: whether the body background is the admin's to own (it comes from outside app/admin), and whether a theme control is wanted at all. ci:admin-contrast passes because it computes token PAIRS, not what the body actually paints — it cannot see this.
